etl.dst_policy: Earlier offset for ambiguous autumn wall times; nonexistent spring times quarantined
etl.deduplication: Valid row with latest observed_at; deterministic SHA256 content tie-breaker

censoring.filter_count_note: Rejection reasons may overlap; rejected_rows is the union.

final_database.window_semantics: Exact PostgreSQL event-ledger recomputation; late arrivals correct windows on refresh; no watermark dropping

streaming.prediction_status: No new predictions written: deduplicated CREATED events do not retrigger scoring; persisted coverage and model versions are reported, without claiming current-model coverage

prediction_summary.current_callback_model_coverage: Not verified: persisted model versions are shown explicitly

deduplication.progress_scope: This invocation's retained Spark recentProgress; older batches beyond Spark retention are not included

aggregation.progress_scope: This invocation's retained Spark recentProgress; older batches beyond Spark retention are not included

watermarked_windows.late_event_policy: Spark drops events older than its watermark; finalized windows cannot be corrected in this append sink. PostgreSQL retains all valid unique events and recomputes exact windows after late arrivals.
watermarked_windows.pending_window_policy: Newest windows remain checkpointed until event time advances beyond the watermark; an empty finalized sink is a valid outcome.
watermarked_windows.source_semantics: Operational historical-event replay, not official CDC; synthetic update events are excluded, injection flags remain explicit
